functions.name: Template — _Layout.cshtml
functions.insertText:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="{{lang}}">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>@ViewData["Title"] - {{application}}</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="~/css/site.css" asp-append-version="true">
</head>
<body>
  <header>{{header}}</header>
  <main role="main">
    @RenderBody()
  </main>
  <script src="~/js/site.js" asp-append-version="true"></script>
  @await RenderSectionAsync("Scripts", required: false)
</body>
</html>

functions.name: CSHTML HTML <head> element
functions.description: Contain document metadata.
functions.longDescription:
Contain document metadata.

Source: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/head
HTML element reference. Global attributes such as id, class, data-*, role and aria-* can be appended through the configurable attribute field when applicable.

This markup is directly usable inside ASP.NET Core MVC and Razor Pages .cshtml files. Razor expressions and Tag Helper attributes can be appended where appropriate.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Optional complete HTML attribute fragment. Use the ... picker to select documented global, data-*, ARIA or inline event attributes, then edit placeholder values when needed. The field remains free-form for element-specific or project-specific attributes. Use the ... picker for documented global, data-*, ARIA or inline event attributes; the field remains editable for asp-* and project-specific fragments.

pickerConfig.title: Select optional HTML attributes

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique document identifier. Leave empty to omit the complete HTML attribute.

parameters.name: className
parameters.description: Space-separated CSS classes. Leave empty to omit the complete HTML attribute.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Optional complete HTML attribute fragment. Use the ... picker to select documented global, data-*, ARIA or inline event attributes, then edit placeholder values when needed. The field remains free-form for element-specific or project-specific attributes. Use the ... picker for documented global, data-*, ARIA or inline event attributes; the field remains editable for asp-* and project-specific fragments.

pickerConfig.title: Select optional HTML attributes

HTML element reference. Global attributes such as id, class, data-*, role and aria-* can be appended through the configurable attribute field when applicable.

This markup is directly usable inside ASP.NET Core MVC and Razor Pages .cshtml files. Razor expressions and Tag Helper attributes can be appended where appropriate.

parameters.name: id

functions.name: CSHTML HTML <h5> element
functions.description: Insert a level-5 heading.
functions.longDescription:
Insert a level-5 heading.

Source: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/h5
HTML element reference. Global attributes such as id, class, data-*, role and aria-* can be appended through the configurable attribute field when applicable.

This markup is directly usable inside ASP.NET Core MVC and Razor Pages .cshtml files. Razor expressions and Tag Helper attributes can be appended where appropriate.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique heading identifier. Leave empty to omit the complete HTML attribute.

parameters.name: className
parameters.description: Space-separated CSS classes. Leave empty to omit the complete HTML attribute.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Optional complete HTML attribute fragment. Use the ... picker to select documented global, data-*, ARIA or inline event attributes, then edit placeholder values when needed. The field remains free-form for element-specific or project-specific attributes. Use the ... picker for documented global, data-*, ARIA or inline event attributes; the field remains editable for asp-* and project-specific fragments.

pickerConfig.title: Select optional HTML attributes
pickerConfig.subtitle: Select one or several global HTML attributes. JC Lib inserts a complete editable fragment. Dedicated element fields such as id, class, href or src remain available on their cards.

functions.name: CSHTML HTML <svg> root element
functions.description: Embed an SVG root element inside HTML.
functions.longDescription:
Embed an SVG root element inside HTML.

Source: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/svg
HTML element reference. Global attributes such as id, class, data-*, role and aria-* can be appended through the configurable attribute field when applicable.

This markup is directly usable inside ASP.NET Core MVC and Razor Pages .cshtml files. Razor expressions and Tag Helper attributes can be appended where appropriate.

parameters.name: viewBox
parameters.description: Coordinate system rectangle. Leave empty to omit the complete HTML attribute.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Rendered width. Leave empty to omit the complete HTML attribute.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Rendered height. Leave empty to omit the complete HTML attribute.

parameters.name: ariaLabel
parameters.description: Accessible description. Leave empty to omit the complete HTML attribute.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Optional complete HTML attribute fragment. Use the ... picker to select documented global, data-*, ARIA or inline event attributes, then edit placeholder values when needed. The field remains free-form for element-specific or project-specific attributes. Use the ... picker for documented global, data-*, ARIA or inline event attributes; the field remains editable for asp-* and project-specific fragments.

pickerConfig.title: Select optional HTML attributes
pickerConfig.subtitle: Select one or several global HTML attributes. JC Lib inserts a complete editable fragment. Dedicated element fields such as id, class, href or src remain available on their cards.

sections.label: Global HTML attributes

items.label: accesskey

items.description: Recommended automatic correction behavior for editable text.

items.description: Select a customized built-in element implementation.

items.description: Content language as a BCP 47 tag.

items.description: Expose a shadow part for ::part() styling.

items.label: slot

items.label: spellcheck
items.description: Enable or disable spelling and grammar checking.

items.label: style
items.description: Inline CSS declarations. Prefer style sheets when practical.

items.label: tabindex
items.description: Focus-navigation position. Prefer 0 or -1 over positive values.

items.label: title
items.description: Advisory text, commonly rendered as a tooltip.

items.label: translate
items.description: Control whether localization tools should translate the content.

items.label: virtualkeyboardpolicy

items.label: writingsuggestions

functions.longDescription:
Group related form controls.

Source: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/fieldset
HTML element reference. Global attributes such as id, class, data-*, role and aria-* can be appended through the configurable attribute field when applicable.

This markup is directly usable inside ASP.NET Core MVC and Razor Pages .cshtml files. Razor expressions and Tag Helper attributes can be appended where appropriate.

HTML element reference. Global attributes such as id, class, data-*, role and aria-* can be appended through the configurable attribute field when applicable.

This markup is directly usable inside ASP.NET Core MVC and Razor Pages .cshtml files. Razor expressions and Tag Helper attributes can be appended where appropriate.

functions.name: CSHTML HTML <datalist> element
functions.description: Provide suggested options for an input.
functions.longDescription:
Provide suggested options for an input.

Source: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/datalist
HTML element reference. Global attributes such as id, class, data-*, role and aria-* can be appended through the configurable attribute field when applicable.

This markup is directly usable inside ASP.NET Core MVC and Razor Pages .cshtml files. Razor expressions and Tag Helper attributes can be appended where appropriate.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier referenced by an input list attribute. Leave empty to omit the complete HTML attribute.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Optional complete HTML attribute fragment. Use the ... picker to select documented global, data-*, ARIA or inline event attributes, then edit placeholder values when needed. The field remains free-form for element-specific or project-specific attributes. Use the ... picker for documented global, data-*, ARIA or inline event attributes; the field remains editable for asp-* and project-specific fragments.

pickerConfig.title: Select optional HTML attributes
pickerConfig.subtitle: Select one or several global HTML attributes. JC Lib inserts a complete editable fragment. Dedicated element fields such as id, class, href or src remain available on their cards.

Represent task progress.

Source: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/progress
HTML element reference. Global attributes such as id, class, data-*, role and aria-* can be appended through the configurable attribute field when applicable.

This markup is directly usable inside ASP.NET Core MVC and Razor Pages .cshtml files. Razor expressions and Tag Helper attributes can be appended where appropriate.

Insert an input control preset for type="date".

Source: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/input
HTML element reference. Global attributes such as id, class, data-*, role and aria-* can be appended through the configurable attribute field when applicable.

This markup is directly usable inside ASP.NET Core MVC and Razor Pages .cshtml files. Razor expressions and Tag Helper attributes can be appended where appropriate.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Optional complete HTML attribute fragment. Use the ... picker to select documented global, data-*, ARIA or inline event attributes, then edit placeholder values when needed. The field remains free-form for element-specific or project-specific attributes. Use the ... picker for documented global, data-*, ARIA or inline event attributes; the field remains editable for asp-* and project-specific fragments.

HTML element reference. Global attributes such as id, class, data-*, role and aria-* can be appended through the configurable attribute field when applicable.

This markup is directly usable inside ASP.NET Core MVC and Razor Pages .cshtml files. Razor expressions and Tag Helper attributes can be appended where appropriate.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Optional complete HTML attribute fragment. Use the ... picker to select documented global, data-*, ARIA or inline event attributes, then edit placeholder values when needed. The field remains free-form for element-specific or project-specific attributes. Use the ... picker for documented global, data-*, ARIA or inline event attributes; the field remains editable for asp-* and project-specific fragments.

The field remains free-form for element-specific or project-specific attributes. Use the ... picker for documented global, data-*, ARIA or inline event attributes; the field remains editable for asp-* and project-specific fragments.

pickerConfig.title: Select optional HTML attributes
pickerConfig.subtitle: Select one or several global HTML attributes. JC Lib inserts a complete editable fragment. Dedicated element fields such as id, class, href or src remain available on their cards.

functions.longDescription:
Insert an input control preset for type="hidden".

Source: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/input
HTML element reference. Global attributes such as id, class, data-*, role and aria-* can be appended through the configurable attribute field when applicable.

This markup is directly usable inside ASP.NET Core MVC and Razor Pages .cshtml files. Razor expressions and Tag Helper attributes can be appended where appropriate.

Source: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/geolocation

functions.name: Reference — ASP.NET Core Razor .cshtml files
functions.insertText: Razor Pages use paired .cshtml and .cshtml.cs files. MVC views and Razor Pages combine HTML markup with C# expressions and directives through Razor syntax.
functions.description: Explain the purpose of .cshtml Razor files.
functions.longDescription:
Explain the purpose of .cshtml Razor files.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/tutorials/razor-pages/razor-pages-start?view=aspnetcore-10.0
functions.declaration: Razor Pages use paired .cshtml and .cshtml.cs files. MVC views and Razor Pages combine HTML markup with C# expressions and directives through Razor syntax.

functions.name: Reference — ASP.NET Core Tag Helpers
functions.insertText: Tag Helpers allow server-side code to participate in generating and rendering HTML elements in Razor files. Built-in Tag Helpers cover forms, links, validation, partials, components, environments, caching and static-resource versioning.
functions.description: Summarize Tag Helper purpose and scope.
functions.longDescription:
Summarize Tag Helper purpose and scope.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/mvc/views/tag-helpers/intro?view=aspnetcore-10.0
functions.declaration: Tag Helpers allow server-side code to participate in generating and rendering HTML elements in Razor files. Built-in Tag Helpers cover forms, links, validation, partials, components, environments, caching and static-resource versioning.

functions.name: Reference — CSHTML HTML optional attribute picker
functions.signature: Reference — CSHTML HTML optional attribute picker
functions.insertText: CSHTML HTML-element cards reuse the complete HTML attribute picker. Dedicated Tag Helper fields expose important asp-* attributes, while the free-form attributes editor remains available for uncommon HTML, aria-*, data-* or Tag Helper fragments.
functions.description: Explain the relationship between HTML attributes and ASP.NET Core Tag Helper attributes.
functions.longDescription:
Explain the relationship between HTML attributes and ASP.NET Core Tag Helper attributes.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/mvc/views/tag-helpers/intro?view=aspnetcore-10.0
functions.declaration: CSHTML HTML-element cards reuse the complete HTML attribute picker. Dedicated Tag Helper fields expose important asp-* attributes, while the free-form attributes editor remains available for uncommon HTML, aria-*, data-* or Tag Helper fragments.

functions.name: Reference — partial view versus view component
functions.signature: Reference — partial view versus view component
functions.insertText: Use partial views for reusable markup without complex rendering logic. Use view components when rendering requires server-side code, dependencies or more substantial logic.
functions.description: Clarify reusable-view choices.
functions.longDescription:
Clarify reusable-view choices.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/mvc/views/partial?view=aspnetcore-10.0
functions.declaration: Use partial views for reusable markup without complex rendering logic. Use view components when rendering requires server-side code, dependencies or more substantial logic.
